insight: Reached a $39B post-money valuation in its Sept 2025 Series C — about 15x its valuation a year earlier.
name: Figure AI
tagline: Humanoid robots powered by Helix, an in-house vision-language-action model.
description: Figure AI builds general-purpose humanoid robots (Figure 01–03) driven by Helix, its proprietary vision-language-action model that fuses perception, language, and learned control. Figure 03, announced in 2025, targets the home and broader applications; earlier models were piloted in BMW's automotive manufacturing.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary VLA model running onboard the robot.

edge: Exited its OpenAI deal to own the full stack — Helix runs onboard, so hardware and AI are built end-to-end in-house.
